## Overview

- Improve the Windows Desktop startup experience and workspace file discovery.
- Publish versioned Windows Store upload packages while retaining separate signed sideloading packages.
- Standardize Latin and Japanese font fallback across the Canvas renderer and PowerPoint export.
- Keep the shared Canvas Extension, Skill, npm CLI, and Desktop product version at 4.2.0.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks and the v4
installation model. Update version-pinned installation links to `v4.2.0` and use the
versioned Store upload package name when preparing Partner Center submission.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.2.0`. |
| Windows Store package preparation | Use `CreateStorePackage.ps1 -Version 4.2.0.0`; the output is named `MarkdStage-Store-4.2.0.msixupload`. |
| Font rendering | Review exported decks if they depend on the previous fallback order; explicit theme font settings remain supported. |
